name: Paper trading of crypto portfolio v9.0 (Gen373 K1): C* on a point-in-time top-10 (monthly, by 30-day volume, live candidates = the 60 pack + extra coins), cascade limit strict, trend 4h, Weiss expiry, deleveraging bounce, ridge ML, alt kimchi; no carry sleeves
registered: 2026-10-25, before the first v9.0 paper hour; runs next to v86 / bf26 (those stay unchanged)
what: Hourly forward test of v8 = v7 (v6 + Gen108/109 ridge ML) + the Gen247 altcoin kimchi sleeve (16 altcoins: Upbit KRW / USD-KRW / Binance perp premium z > 1 long 0.1, < -1 short 0.1, held next day, 5 bp + funding). The ridge ML sleeve is (BTC/ETH perps: ridge regression on 17 daily features, refit monthly on all earlier data, prediction / training sd clipped to +-1, position 0.5 x prediction, decided at the 00:00 UTC close, 5 bp taker + funding). Same construction as v6: point-in-time equal risk (Weiss half weight), 30-day vol targeting. Simulation only.

frozen.daily_stop: flat for the rest of the UTC day once the day's loss reaches 50% of the firm's 5% daily loss limit (2.5%), exit 10 bp worse (Gen230 setting)
frozen.costs: as in research: C* 7.5 bp, premium carry / trend / Weiss 5 bp taker, cascade 2 bp maker entry + 5 bp exit, real funding; deleveraging bounce and ridge ML 5 bp taker + funding
frozen.booking: cascade entry fee in the fill hour and Weiss legs as each bar closes (live=True); same totals as research
frozen.risk_note: Gen323 supersedes Gen318: HyroTrader caps funded open notional at 2x the initial balance; challenge risk 2.0 (no cap in the evaluation), FUNDED risk 1.5 with an exposure cap of 1.9x and a $1,000 no-trade band (research/FIRM_RULES_EXECUTION.md). The paper ledger runs at the challenge risk 2.0.
frozen.ridge_inputs: Binance 5m/funding/premium/open interest (as v6), Coinbase BTC/ETH hourly, Upbit KRW hourly + Yahoo USD/KRW (kimchi, Gen105 strict London dating, previous day's FX), Deribit DVOL daily, Coin Metrics USDT+USDC caps (2-day lag); scripts/ridge_live.py, live feeds src/qpl/live/ml_feeds.py; v8 adds Upbit KRW hourly for 16 altcoins (src/qpl/live/ml_feeds.py, alts=True); v8.4 adds Binance spot BTC/ETH hourly with taker-buy volume (src/qpl/live/ml_feeds.py spot) and the DVOL level
frozen.extra_data: Binance perps of the 40 extra coins (C* candidates; live via binance_public.update_extra)
frozen.reference: Gen373 K1 (candidates incl. delisted coins): 2.394 / 1.053 / 3.548 / 2.055; planning Sharpe 1.37
frozen.v90_scale_note: 0.15 / realised vol 2022-26 of the point-in-time v9.0 book (paper_v5.py _dump on the research pack, 2026-10-25, live candidates): 2.423 / 1.104 / 3.588 / 2.051, vol 0.1695; Gen373 version incl. delisted candidates 2.394 (corr 0.997) is the planning reference

frozen_ledger: Each completed hour is computed once, with only the data available at that moment, and never revised. Hours computed more than 2 hours after they closed are flagged late.

gate.minimum: 56 days of paper results and at least 2 Weiss expiry events
gate.reconciliation: recompute the period with the final data: hourly portfolio P&L correlation >= 0.99 and |cumulative difference| <= 0.5% of the account; otherwise find and fix the cause before going further
gate.operations: late or missed hours <= 5% of hours; no data errors
gate.performance: z = (paper mean daily return - backtest mean) / (backtest daily sd / sqrt(days)), backtest = v9.0 2023-01..2026-09 at the same risk. GO if z > -1; EXTEND to 112 days if -2 <= z <= -1; STOP if z < -2 or the paper drawdown is worse than -12%
gate.honesty_note: 56 days cannot prove the edge (one standard error is about the whole expected return). The paper test mainly proves that the pipeline runs live without look-ahead, data gaps or execution surprises.
